SELECT
  f.*,

  p.nombre AS proveedor_nombre_db,
  p.cuit_dni AS proveedor_cuit_db,

  cg.name AS cost_group_name,
  cg.description AS cost_group_description,

  cc.name AS cost_center_name,
  cc.description AS cost_center_description

FROM facturas_rpa f
LEFT JOIN proveedores_rpa p ON p.id = f.proveedor_id
LEFT JOIN cost_groups cg ON cg.id = f.cost_group_id
LEFT JOIN cost_centers cc ON cc.id = f.cost_center_id
WHERE f.id = {{ $('Build update query').first().json.id }}
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  cg.id AS group_id,
  cg.name AS group_name,
  cg.description AS group_description,
  cg.is_active AS group_is_active,

  cc.id AS center_id,
  cc.name AS center_name,
  cc.description AS center_description,
  cc.is_active AS center_is_active

FROM cost_groups cg
LEFT JOIN cost_centers cc
  ON cc.cost_group_id = cg.id
  AND cc.is_active = 1
WHERE cg.is_active = 1
ORDER BY cg.name ASC, cc.name ASC;

SELECT
  f.*,
  cg.name AS cost_group_name,
  cc.name AS cost_center_name
FROM facturas_rpa f
LEFT JOIN cost_groups cg ON cg.id = f.cost_group_id
LEFT JOIN cost_centers cc ON cc.id = f.cost_center_id
WHERE f.id = {{ $json.id }}
LIMIT 1;
